# Aeterna Wealth - Indian mutual fund research

> Track-record ratings, returns vs total-return benchmarks, risk, costs, holdings and portfolio overlap for every Indian equity and index mutual fund. Published by Aeterna Wealth Private Limited, AMFI-registered mutual fund distributor (ARN-317889). Ratings describe past track records and are not forecasts or investment advice.

## Open data
- [All funds, latest metrics (JSON)](https://aeternawealth.com/data/funds.json)
- [Dataset dates and sources (JSON)](https://aeternawealth.com/data/meta.json)
